summary: Bind checkpoint resume and excusal body actors to the authenticated agent identity

rules.detail: Checkpoint agreement and trim rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Agent-bound callers of checkpoint mutation routes must name their own actor, including when no identity header is supplied. Existing person/operator requests and authorized local trim-owner resumes remain supported. Writer excusal remains person-only.

recovery.detail: No data migration; rollback restores the previous actor-binding behavior.
